mechanism: Citalopram inhibits renal potassium excretion through SERT inhibition and decreased norepinephrine activity, increasing hyperkalemia risk, particularly in patients with renal impairment or on concurrent ACE inhibitors/ARBs.
action: Monitor serum potassium levels periodically, especially in elderly patients or those with renal dysfunction; assess need for potassium supplementation and consider baseline and periodic ECG monitoring.
